title: Congruence modulo m is an equivalence relation
statement: For every natural modulus m and every bound n, congruence modulo m (a ≡ b mod m) is reflexive, symmetric and transitive on natural numbers below n.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.modEq_equivalence_on : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> AxNat.equivalenceOn (AxNat.modEq x0) x1))

notes: `Nat.EquivalenceOn r n := ReflexiveOn r n ∧ SymmetricOn r n ∧ TransitiveOn r n`, and `ReflexiveOn r n := ∀ i, i < n → r i i` (similarly for the other two) -- so this theorem is bounded to naturals below `n`, not an unbounded claim over all of ℕ, and the prose statement reflects that bound rather than overclaiming.
